# Wayaroo

> Wayaroo is a free map app for Australia from Ozrsym Pty Ltd (Melbourne). It puts live public transport, trip planning with fares, turn-by-turn directions with safety warnings, fuel prices, weather and public toilets on one map, in 20 languages, with no account. The iPhone and iPad app is on the App Store (https://apps.apple.com/app/wayaroo-maps-transport/id6831237478, free). The web app is at https://app.wayaroo.com/ (free, no download). The Android app is in review at Google Play.

## What it does
- Live buses, trains, trams and ferries on the map: Melbourne and regional Victoria (Transport Victoria feed), Sydney and NSW (Transport for NSW feeds, Sydney Ferries included), Brisbane, the Gold Coast, the Sunshine Coast and Cairns (Translink feed), Adelaide (Adelaide Metro feed), Canberra (Transport Canberra feed), and about 440 operators in 19 other countries (operators' open GTFS feeds; a vehicle's mode comes from the operator's timetable). Not live: Perth (timetable times only), Hobart, Darwin, New Zealand. Shows delay, next stops, "usually late" and "often full" at this time, nearest stops and wharves with next departures.
- Trip planner: Melbourne (own planner, Myki fares) and Sydney/NSW (Transport for NSW's planner, Opal fare estimate), with a connection check (spare minutes at each change), replacement-bus flags and a step-free option.
- Directions by car, bike or foot: lane arrows, speed limit, school zones, speed humps, level-crossing wait, crash hotspots, long-light warnings, truck mode (height and weight limits), share-my-trip link, rain at destination.
- Fuel: cheapest station for your fuel type within the distance you choose, whether the detour is worth it, and when to fill up from the local price cycle. NSW Government FuelCheck and Tasmanian Government FuelCheck TAS prices plus driver-shared prices; Victoria's official Servo Saver prices are being connected.
- Trip planner: one row of tabs with each way's time (car, public transport, bike, walking) and a Victorian taxi estimate; the chosen way's card, Start and its other routes under it. Bike and walking cards say how hilly the way is (metres up and down, from open terrain data). The bike card says how much of the ride is on bike paths or lanes (OpenStreetMap).
- Toll prices for cars (Melbourne): West Gate Tunnel about $4.26 (inbound city exits $6.82 on weekday mornings), CityLink up to $12.77, EastLink up to $8.05, from the prices Linkt and EastLink publish.
- Taxi fare estimate (Victoria): for a trip that starts in Melbourne, Dandenong, Frankston, the Mornington Peninsula, Geelong, Ballarat or Bendigo, about what a taxi from a rank or hailed in the street costs, from the Victorian Government's maximum fares (Safe Transport Victoria, in force from 1 July 2026), with the day, overnight or peak rate. Tolls, airport and card fees are extra. No prices of booked taxis or rideshare.
- EV chargers: power (kW), plug types, number of charging points and price where known; a filter for fast (50 kW+) or ultra-fast (150 kW+) chargers and for the car's plug (CCS, CHAdeMO, Type 2, Type 1, Tesla/NACS); chargers along the route in navigation. Sources: Victorian Government (DEECA), Open Charge Map (open-licence providers only), OpenStreetMap. Chargers for e-bikes, scooters and boats are left out.
- Public toilets across Australia (National Public Toilet Map) with hours and accessibility, plus customer toilets in shops, libraries and servos.
- Weather and air quality on the map (NOAA GFS), today's forecast, UV and clothing advice.
- 20 languages: en, zh, zh-Hant, hi, pa, ar, vi, el, it, fil, es, ne, bn, ur, ta, ko, ja, id, fr, de.

## Where to get it
- iPhone and iPad: [Wayaroo: Maps & Transport on the App Store](https://apps.apple.com/app/wayaroo-maps-transport/id6831237478) (free).
- Any phone or computer: https://app.wayaroo.com/ in the browser (free, no account).
- Android: in review at Google Play.

## Facts
- Publisher: Ozrsym Pty Ltd, Victoria, Australia. Contact: support@wayaroo.com
- Price: free. No account. Settings stay on the phone.
- No pop-ups or banners while driving or navigating.
- Every data source is credited and used under a commercial-friendly licence.
